title: EOCRFEZ-WRAZ7WA - EOCR-FEZ digital over current relay with ground fault, 0.5–60 A, 85–250 V AC/DC
range_short_desc: Digital over-current relay with ground-fault protection
description: EOCR-FEZ digital over current relay with a separate ground-fault element, separate-display (remote panel) type. Protects against over-current, under-current, phase loss, phase unbalance, phase reversal, locked rotor and ground fault, with a digital ammeter and trip-cause indication. This variant: current range 0.5–60 A, control voltage 85–250 V AC/DC. Output is a 1-SPST overload contact (97-98) plus a dedicated ground-fault relay (57-58), with the ZCT wired to Z1-Z2.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Selectable trip time characteristics (inverse or definite)
Independently adjustable starting trip delay (D-TIME) and trip time (O-TIME)

specs.group: This variant (as marked on the box)

rows: Control voltage (family) : 24 V AC/DC, 110 V AC ±15 %, 220 V AC ±15 %
Contact rating : 3 A / 250 V AC resistive
An external CT should be used when the inverse curve (tc In setting) is applied above 10 A.
Ground fault current setting : type A 0.02–3 A / type B 0.2–10 A
